findings.summary: `just check` could run live provider and local-provider tests because it called plain pytest while `just` dotenv loading could import ancestor credentials.
findings.recommendation: Make the default `test` and `check` lanes provider-free by unsetting provider credential env vars, forcing a null keyring backend, and excluding `e2e`; keep live exercises behind explicit recipes.
findings.evidence: Initial `just check` attempts ran credential/live paths; after the justfile change, escalated `just check` passed with 5132 passed, 10 skipped, 24 deselected, and 1 xfailed.

lanes.notes: Bug/regression review found and fixed the default-gate/live-test leak; the explicit live recipes remain available and still carry their credential or local-service gates.
Simplification review kept the existing recipe structure and made the smallest command-level change needed to align local `check` with CI's provider-free blocking posture.
